description: Perform an audit on the existing 'My Portfolio' by updating the broker fees and comments for all buy transactions. There are three existing transactions (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA) that currently have no recorded broker fee. You must update EACH transaction to have a Broker Fee of 2.99 and set the Comment to 'Fee Audited'. Navigate to the Portfolio Management tab, edit each of the three buy transactions, input '2.99' in the Broker field and 'Fee Audited' in the Comment field, and save your changes.
